training_policy.replication_seed_scope: each replication seed controls both model RNG and dataset ordering; corpus construction remains fixed at seed 42

learning_rate_prescription.source: JointMoE paper arXiv:2502.05172, printed rounded-coefficient law
learning_rate_prescription.parameter_count_basis: paper-style active non-embedding parameter count N_act_nonembed

prescribed_learning_rate_verification.schedule: linear warmup to each cell's prescribed peak learning rate, then constant peak learning rate

learning_rate_transfer_diagnostic.clear_improvement_threshold: larger than the same cell's three-seed 1x primary-validation loss range
learning_rate_transfer_diagnostic.block_rule: block if the same neighboring multiplier clearly improves at least three of four cells

seed_replication_panel.inference_scope: descriptive A/B uncertainty reference; not a formal confidence interval or a C/D seed-variance estimate
